# Retention schedule (generated)

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m hs_core.retention.render` from services/core/src/hs_core/retention/policy.py. Do not edit by hand: edit the policy and regenerate. A test fails when this file is stale. -->

**Status: DRAFT for the lawyer (brief Q4, Q16, Q17, Q23-Q26). Every period marked "placeholder" is a conservative default (kept LONGER than likely needed) and has NOT been confirmed.** The purge job only reports what it would do (dry run) until the owner enables `RETENTION_ENFORCE`. Mechanism, settings and safeguards: `docs/legal/retention.md` and `docs/ops/retention.md`.

How to read it: a row is **due** when today's Africa/Kampala date is after (Kampala date of the clock + the period); it is kept through the whole last day. Month and year steps that land on a day that does not exist roll forward (kept one day longer). **Floor** is the legal minimum the code enforces: a configured period shorter than the floor is refused at startup. **On deletion request** is what a data-subject deletion does (DP-5): `delete`, `anonymise` (personal fields replaced, amounts kept), `retain` (kept: legal basis or proof) or `none`.

## Order of purging

Children before parents (references are restricted, cascaded or replaced by a pseudonym): `access_window`, `assessment_item`, `assessment`, `assessment_blueprint`, `assignment`, `audit_log`, `availability_exception`, `availability_slot`, `bonus_rule`, `cancellation`, `case_status`, `catalogue_version`, `feedback`, `handover_rating`, `handover_summary`, `school_upload`, `session_log_struggle`, `session_log_topic`, `session_log`, `topic_progress`, `child`, `consent_record`, `curriculum`, `deletion_request`, `device_token`, `dispute`, `earning`, `guardian_link`, `home_location`, `invoice`, `ledger_account`, `ledger_entry`, `ledger_transaction`, `level`, `level_equivalence`, `match_offer`, `match_request`, `notification`, `notification_preference`, `notification_template`, `otp_challenge`, `parent_profile`, `payment`, `payout`, `payout_batch`, `plan`, `policy_acceptance`, `question`, `retention_hold`, `retention_run`, `role_assignment`, `safeguarding_action`, `safeguarding_case`, `sample_item`, `schema_migration`, `session_checkin`, `session`, `session_confirmation`, `strand`, `struggle_tag`, `subject`, `subscription`, `teacher_approval`, `teacher_document`, `teacher_session_history`, `teacher_zone`, `tier_history`, `teacher_profile`, `tier`, `topic`, `travel_time_cache`, `travel_usage`, `user_profile`, `zone`.

## Holds

A legal hold (`retention_hold`: child, parent, teacher, user, safeguarding case or one row) stops any purge or anonymisation of the subject's rows. An open safeguarding case holds its child and its teacher automatically. Rows inherit the holds of the rows they reference.
